correctness.rationale: The invariant-curve cofactor and physical-time angular equation follow by direct differentiation. The admissible b-range is an exact optimization with unique critical point; quarter-turn symmetry and positive differentiated integral give strict convexity and the exact minimum. Each endpoint has exactly two equal quadratic zeros with explicit first parameter and second angular derivatives; standard rescaled dominated convergence yields the period/occupation/Cauchy limits. Integration of the same exact normal cofactor gives the sharp Floquet limits and signs. Original-time normalization and one-sided parameter quantifiers are explicit. Standalone numerical checks were successfully replayed, but are not used as infinite proofs.
